title: Desk wake writes only through desk_write.py: draft -> derived row -> validate -> CAS; stat-match rule in guard + mirror
note: [2026-10-27 lane desk-wake-write] MEASURED over all 15 rows on desk/decisions (tip bfe3f6e): 15/15 schema- and guard-valid. Write path by commit author: 7 plain git push (noreply@anthropic.com: 1631Z, 1743Z and every row from 2301Z on) vs 8 GitHub-tool (user author); none of the 7 ran the brief's validation or CAS. Stat-match against the row's own packet: 14/15 exact, 1/15 rounded to 3 d.p. (2002Z, harmless), and 1/15 (0501Z) mixed horizons: long h12 (n973, -0.036) beside the h48 BTC short row (n937, -1.237; the h12 short is n973, -0.545). Cause (INFERRED, not observable from the branch): the brief was 23 KB with a 10 KB schema block and three write paths; validation was a checklist to run by eye; the guard that validates runs only on main after the mirror and never compared statistics to the packet; the sparse checkout (.claude/skills/trading-desk only) cannot run the guard (imports src/ and scripts/ci). FIX: .claude/skills/trading-desk/desk_write.py (stdlib, run from origin/main): the wake writes a short draft, the script derives ids/shas/cutoff/novelty/onboarding and EVERY alternatives[] statistic from the packet, validates (schema from origin/main + guard rules) and pushes a non-forced commit (CAS). check_desk_records.py and the mirror load its alt_stat_problems (mirror: skip + ::warning::, never a stop). Brief 23.4 KB -> 9.9 KB. Tests: tests/test_desk_wake_write.py (CAS race, stale, 12 refusals, writer==guard drift). NOT FIXED: alternatives[] has no horizon field so a real-row-wrong-horizon is undetectable after the fact (the draft now names the horizon); a wake that ignores the brief and git-pushes by hand still lands (branch has no server-side check).
